timecoded_text_to_speech.text: For the NCB Manilano, Red Lotus is really very helpful to us,
especially in the management of our borders.
With the Red Lotus, the Interpol have trained us
in the way how to process these people crossing our borders
from other countries, especially from Indonesia, Malaysia,
and other parts of the ASEAN region.
This is a conglomeration of law enforcement agencies
such as the Bureau of Immigration, the Costums,
the National Police, and other law enforcement agencies
with police functions.
That is why we are very glad that Interpol have given us
this opportunity to have trained with them
with the Interpol assistance.
We can have this coordination with other countries
we are being for one from Indonesia or Malaysia,
or other parts of the ASEAN nation
if there are some persons interest coming in to our country.
We are very grateful for this because it is the efforts
of the Interpol.
Now we are also having this collaboration
with other countries through ASEAN,
but it was the Interpol that first introduced
this kind of coordination with other countries.
